title: Lent Sundays III-V: should the Year-A ('a') antiphon sets also be 'cum Evangelio de …' instead of Year A?
prompt: In #13 you ruled B* (5Q1, Lazarus) → option_txt 'cum Evangelio de Lazaro', not tied to Year A, because "any parish might use the A Gospel in any year". OCO's Lent Sundays III, IV and V each have full a/b/c sets: Ba/Bb/Bc (Lauds), Ma/Mb/Mc (II Vespers) and T/S/N a/b/c — 27 rows marked 'a' across 3Q1 (Samaritan woman: 'Aqua quam', 'Spiritus est Deus', 'Domine ut video' …), 4Q1 (man born blind: 'Rabbi quid peccavit', 'A saeculo non est auditum', 'Ille homo' …) and 5Q1 (Lazarus: 'Domine ecce quem', 'Clamabat Dominus Iesus', 'Lazarus amicus' (T a) …). Today they load (or will) with cycle_sun = 1 (Year A); b/c with cycle_sun 2/3. Should the 'a' rows instead carry no cycle_sun and option_txt 'cum Evangelio de Samaritana' / 'de caeco nato' / 'de Lazaro' (shown every year next to the year's b/c antiphon)? Nothing changes until you answer; the #13 B* row is already loaded that way.

options.label: Yes: 'a' sets → option_txt, no year
options.detail: 3Q1/4Q1/5Q1 rows with place a/Ba/Ma: cycle_sun NULL, option_txt 'cum Evangelio de Samaritana' / 'de caeco nato' / 'de Lazaro'; b/c keep Years B/C

options.label: No: keep Year A
options.detail: only B* is year-free; the 'a' sets stay cycle_sun 1
